title: Harden numerical capability and result contracts
objective: Derive the public surface from runtime capabilities, expose honest qualification/provenance/budget/outward-code contracts, and validate them exhaustively

handoff.summary: The numerical surface is derived exhaustively from the live public registry and actual frontend registrations: 49 capabilities, 22 frontend operations, and 17 diagnostics are classified without a second hardcoded ledger. Common problem, plan, result, trace, provenance, resource-budget, outward-code, and receipt contracts now fail closed: nested records are immutable, schemas cover the records domains actually emit, result/plan identities and counters are validated, external execution is qualified only by matching observed artifacts and receipts, and unexecuted external plans remain explicitly unobserved. npm is a first-class qualification subject. Collector-authenticated peak-memory evidence has exact method/scope rules, and collection rebinds source, corpus, adapter, artifact, capability, and clean repository identity after execution. The final Linux x64 checks recorded here pass strict Python, every architecture gate, and 44 focused contract, receipt, gallery, optimization, and ODE tests.
risks: Process-tree RSS is an explicitly sampled measurement, not an instantaneous operating-system high-water mark; its stable method ID and sample interval preserve that limitation.

Receipts trust the first-party collector, adapter, and host. Exact pre/post rebinding detects persistent or concurrent input changes but does not claim hostile-host attestation or prove a mutate-use-restore attack impossible.

The exact final tip did not complete another monolithic pnpm test:numerics run: prior attempts exposed and fixed only stale generated gallery provenance, and integration directed this lane to stop rerunning the full suite. Exact final focused tests are 44/44, strict Python is clean, and architecture is green.
Persistent Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 receipts remain P8 release qualification evidence rather than claims made by this lane.
next_steps: Independently review and integrate this P0 contract branch with P8's runtime-matrix work; this lane did not edit package-qualification runtime or process-supervisor files.
Collect new four-platform receipts at the exact integrated candidate and require each matrix row's declared memory scope; retain missing evidence as missing and do not backfill old receipts.
Keep aliases, parser mappings, emitters, implementation targets, and receipt-qualified runtimes independently classified as their public registries evolve.
